findings.title: Escape must retire the captured Box gesture
findings.trigger: Arm Box, press the primary pointer on the canvas and drag, press Escape while holding the pointer, then release it.
findings.mechanism: The shell Escape handler disarms only creation tools. Box state and boxGestureRef live in PipeViewport and receive no Escape cancellation. The candidate at PipeViewport.tsx:1683–1695 remains captured; pointer-up at 1781–1801 applies and publishes it. Workspace Select likewise only calls handleArmCreationTool(null), so its apparent return to selection does not cancel Box.
findings.impact: A gesture the user cancelled still replaces or modifies ordered selection on release; the rectangle and Box mode can remain active after Escape.
findings.remediation: Route the shared cancel/select command to a Box cancellation primitive that clears the candidate before releasing capture, removes the rectangle, and disarms the mode. Retain separate ordinary pointer/orbit handling.
findings.verification_required: Real held-pointer Escape and Select cancellation controls must prove no delayed move/up revival, no selection/action publication, and unchanged camera; retain positive Box selection controls.

findings.title: Reject a Box candidate after its model or project session is replaced
findings.trigger: Begin a Box drag, then replace the project (including same-ID Open) before pointer-up. An ordinary model replacement while the pointer remains held has the same missing generation admission.
findings.mechanism: The session effect clears boxSelectActive and boxRect but leaves boxGestureRef and native capture alive. Model/selection invalidation uses clearPointerPlacement (1632–1636), which only retires the separate placement candidate. Box stores neither model/session generation nor interaction epoch at 1683–1693. Delayed move at 1699–1706 recreates the rectangle; up at 1781–1799 selects against the current model/index/camera with the old rectangle.
findings.impact: A stale interaction can overwrite the new project selection after New/Open, violating transient session reset and potentially acting on unrelated same-ID entities.
findings.remediation: Bind the candidate to an explicit model/session or interaction generation, cancel capture synchronously on invalidating transitions, and validate that binding on both move and up. Use the central cancellation route for mode/context invalidation as well.
findings.verification_required: Held-pointer same-ID Open/New and ordinary model-replacement controls must show no rectangle revival or late selection publication; verify ordinary current-generation Box still works.

findings.title: Preserve the existing model-tree search fields
findings.trigger: Filter a support by a restraint such as UX, a pipe by its material, or an entity by provenance/component geometry/reference fields that are absent from its ID and label.
findings.mechanism: indexedTreeItem replaces the former type-specific keyword lists with a short list of scalar fields. The base included support.restraints.join(" "), hanger type/source/consumption, pipe.material, provenance, and componentKeyword geometry/reference terms. None is included in the new list; matchesTreeItem at 420–425 reads only that reduced list and display labels.
findings.impact: Existing useful searches silently return no matching entity after this virtualization rewrite. For {id:"s",label:"Anchor",node:"n",restraints:["UX"],provenance:"source"}, UX matched the support in the base and does not match it now.
findings.remediation: Restore the previous per-type search vocabulary in the indexed representation, adding the new diagnostic/geometry fields without removing existing terms. Preserve virtual rendering and current typed ordering.
findings.verification_required: Focused tests with terms appearing only in restraints, hanger/source, pipe material, provenance and component reference/geometry should retain the old matches; do not derive the expectations from the new keyword builder.

findings.title: Update the maintained current benchmark recipe and freezer arguments
findings.trigger: Use the maintained README to understand or execute the current candidate qualification.
findings.mechanism: Lines 36–38 and 106–108 claim the candidate global RAF is not wrapped, but the current causal/full-cohort instrumented method wraps the genuine callback path. The documented freeze-candidate-point-oracle.mjs command provides only preflight/output directories although the current script also requires --visual-tokens, --cue-source and --geometry-source.
findings.impact: The method description misstates the observation boundary and the published freezer command fails immediately, preventing reproducible use of the documented workflow.
findings.remediation: Describe the current instrumented qualification and its causal/observer limits, clearly label historical contracts, and provide the complete current bound-input argument pattern. Preserve explicitly historical observer/baseline records.
findings.verification_required: File-only check that the runnable parameter pattern matches the script parser and that current-method claims match the harness/controller.
